title: OutlineWars 16x
description: This is a texture pack for BedWars created by the SquadXTeam. It will provide you with a FPS boost as well as a lot more
body:
Overview: Looking for a clean, distraction-free, and stylish PvP pack for Java Edition? OutlineWars is built specifically for BedWars and SkyWars players who want max FPS and perfect visibility without losing visual appeal. Featuring a unique heavy-outline aesthetic!

✨ Key Features:

Heavy Outlines: All blocks (wool, glass, etc.) and items feature bold, black borders for a striking, cartoonish look. This makes bridging and block placement incredibly precise.

Micro-Weapons: All swords and tools are significantly shortened. Your screen stays clean, giving you a massive advantage during intense PvP fights.

Mini Consumables: Golden apples, ender pearls, and fire charges are downsized and optimized for a clear field of view.

Clean & Flat Colors: Removed all unnecessary "noise" from blocks. The textures are flat and vibrant, making it easy to spot enemies from across the map.

High FPS: 16x16 resolution ensures your game runs smoothly even on low-end PCs.

⚙️ Perfect for: BedWars, SkyWars, Duels, and Bridge practice.
